about.title: About Number Oasis
about.body1: Number Oasis helps children aged 6 to 12 understand addition, subtraction, multiplication and division with short visual lessons, gentle practice and calm games, in English or Arabic.
about.body2: There are no ads, no accounts, no chat and no trackers. Learning progress stays on this device.
about.body3: Grown-ups can see progress, change settings, and back up or delete data in the Grown-ups Area.
